manuscript_scope: Nine source segments 7..15 over LP2-00..55. Join pages within each source segment and never compare across a segment boundary: 12,947 eligible adjacent pairs; 86 equal. This differs from the site's page-only 12,901-pair convention. Source page/line markers are preserved per rune.

checks.H-L1: Nonzero difference histogram over 28 GP residues against an equal-spread z rule, with source cutoff |z| 3.5.
checks.H-L2: Within-written-line, line-break and page-break equal pairs; page-break pairs also count as line-break. Source 2.5 percent and binomial rules.
checks.H-L3: Doublet positions modulo each period 2..32 with segment-relative and joined-stream clocks; source phase-size-aware union-bound p, Bonferroni .01/62.
checks.H-L4: Nine-segment equal-rate chi-square and 500-pair nonoverlapping window dispersion; source p>.01 and dispersion 0.5..2.
checks.H-L5: On fixed solved plaintext, ideal and literal two-key switch generators under DIVINITY/CIRCUMFERENCES and phi(prime)/prime key streams; compare resulting rate with 86 source doublets under source Poisson upper tail 1e-6.
checks.O-C14: Source skip-next-key LLR of 28 nonzero ciphertext differences using solved plaintext-difference distribution and fixed 0.19 key-repeat rate; cutoff -10 nats, plus planted skip/fresh rekey controls and disjoint solved-text halves.

limits: These are finite diagnostics, not decryption of LP2 or proof against all doublet avoidance. H-L5 uses two named key pairs and a solved-text transfer. O-C14's 0.19 repeat rate and solved-text difference model are assumptions. P-values do not correct for historical hypothesis search beyond the declared period scan.
